featured_reviews.name: Sanika Walujkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointing experience at Enrich Salon.

Firstly, we called the salon to ask about appointments and were told that same-day appointments were possible with just 1 hour’s notice. Fair enough. However, when we called back just 15 minutes later to book for 2 hours later, suddenly there was “no availability.” Fine, we still gave them the benefit of the doubt.

The real nightmare started with the haircut.

My hair used to reach my lower back, and I VERY clearly told the stylist multiple times not to cut it too short. I even showed him the exact length I wanted and a reference picture of the haircut. Despite this, he chopped my hair to almost HALF its original length — now it barely reaches my shoulders.

I am genuinely heartbroken and extremely upset. Hair takes years to grow, and now I’m stuck with a haircut I absolutely hate for probably more than a year. On top of that, he styled it in a completely different way from the picture I showed him. Instead of listening to what I wanted, it honestly felt like he was experimenting on my hair according to his own preferences.

When I expressed my concern about how short it had become, he insisted that it was “the same look” as the reference picture — which it clearly was not.

To make things worse, when we went to pay the bill, they charged us almost DOUBLE the amount that was discussed on the call. We literally had to stand there arguing and reminding them what had been promised earlier.

Another disappointing thing is that the staff does not inform customers about the ongoing offers unless YOU specifically mention them yourself. They conveniently stay silent unless you already know about the discounts.

Overall, this was one of the worst salon experiences I’ve ever had. I left feeling upset, emotionally drained, and completely lacking confidence in my appearance.

Would never recommend Enrich Salon to anyone again.posting my before and after photos.
